# Acme Cloud Services -- Order Form

This fictional Order Form between Halvard Systems and Acme Cloud Services covers managed cloud infrastructure and hosting services and the commercial terms that apply to it. It is synthetic evaluation data, not legal advice and not a real agreement.

## Term and Renewal

The term of this Order Form runs from 2026-07-05 to 2028-07-05 with no automatic renewal. Acme Cloud Services shall tell Halvard Systems at least forty-five (45) days before expiry whether it intends to propose renewal terms.

## Payment Terms

Fees are due thirty (30) days after the invoice date. Halvard Systems may withhold payment of a disputed invoice line while the dispute is open, and Acme Cloud Services may charge two percent (2%) per month on undisputed overdue amounts.

## Limitation of Liability

Liability is capped. The aggregate liability of Halvard Systems and of Acme Cloud Services for all claims under this Order Form is limited to the fees paid in the three (3) months preceding the claim. This cap does not apply to breaches of confidentiality, to data protection breaches, or to unpaid fees, for which liability remains uncapped.

## Notices

Notices under this Order Form are effective when sent to contracts@halvard.example.com for Halvard Systems and to contracts@acmecloud.example.com for Acme Cloud Services, with delivery confirmed in writing. Either party may change its notice address by giving notice in the same way.

## Signatures

Executed by Tobias Renner (Head of Vendor Management) for Halvard Systems and by Dara Okonjo (VP Customer Accounts) for Acme Cloud Services. The signatories are fictional characters created for this synthetic corpus.
